headline: Adopt {arm:brisk-s.low.r1}: it meets both gates at {measure.cost_per_1k.brisk-s.low.r1.mean|usd_per_1k}.
lede: {arm:brisk-s.low.r1} is the only configuration to clear the {criteria.pass_rate.threshold|pct} Pass rate gate while keeping tail Latency budget (p95) under {criteria.p95.threshold}. Relaxing Latency budget (p95) above {criteria.p95.brisk-s.high.r1.value} would unlock higher accuracy on {arm:brisk-s.high.r1}.

slots.text: Deploy {arm:brisk-s.low.r1}. It achieves {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.value|pct} Pass rate and {criteria.p95.brisk-s.low.r1.value} tail latency at {measure.cost_per_1k.brisk-s.low.r1.mean|usd_per_1k}.

{arm:atlas-m.high.r1} misses Latency budget (p95) at {criteria.p95.atlas-m.high.r1.value}; {arm:brisk-s.high.r1} misses Latency budget (p95) at {criteria.p95.brisk-s.high.r1.value}; {arm:nano-xs.off.r0} misses Pass rate at {criteria.pass_rate.nano-xs.off.r0.value|pct}.

{weakest.arm} achieves {weakest.value|pct} against {weakest.criterion} at {weakest.threshold|pct}, a clearance margin of {weakest.margin|pts} points. Slices with multi-hop dependencies remain the most fragile failure mode.
Run an online canary test for {arm:brisk-s.low.r1} to verify production tail latencies stay below {criteria.p95.threshold} under peak concurrency.

method.text: Evaluated across {scoreboard.brisk-s.low.r1.cases} synthetic query planning benchmark cases stratified across four task categories.
A case passes when the executed tool sequence returns the gold target or appropriately requests user clarification.
Calculated as p50 and p95 elapsed duration in milliseconds across task runs including retries.
Derived from measured input and output tokens multiplied by published list prices per thousand planner invocations.
Requires an overall mean Pass rate of at least {criteria.pass_rate.threshold|pct}.
Requires a p95 Latency budget (p95) under {criteria.p95.threshold} overall.

explore.title: Adjust Gates
explore.recomputes: Adjusting the p95 latency ceiling changes which arms pass. At or above {criteria.p95.brisk-s.high.r1.value}, {arm:brisk-s.high.r1} qualifies with higher accuracy.

Higher reasoning tiers push tail latency beyond {criteria.p95.threshold}: {arm:atlas-m.high.r1} reaches {criteria.p95.atlas-m.high.r1.value} and {arm:brisk-s.high.r1} reaches {criteria.p95.brisk-s.high.r1.value}.
